title: JewelMindCapabilityCoverage
description: The Capability Coverage Guard (brief section 45). One authoritative cross-product record of what JewelMind can and cannot do, so a capability can never be quietly assumed. CURRENT requires real implementation AND tests; PARTIAL, PLANNED, BLOCKED and OUT_OF_SCOPE must be recorded honestly. Validated by backend/tests/test_capability_coverage.py.

note.description: Why this status is accurate. For CURRENT, what implements it. For anything else, what is genuinely missing or blocked.
